parameters.name: DefenseType
parameters.description: The type of the protection rule.

parameters.name: InstanceId
parameters.description:
The ID of the WAF instance.

> You can call [DescribeInstance](~~433756~~) to query the ID of the current WAF instance.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description:
The region where the WAF instance is deployed. Valid values:

- **cn-hangzhou**: the Chinese mainland.

- **ap-southeast-1**: outside the Chinese mainland.

parameters.name: Resource
parameters.description:
The protection object associated with the rule to delete.
> This parameter is required only when **DefenseType** is set to **resource**.

parameters.name: ResourceManagerResourceGroupId
parameters.description: The ID of the Alibaba Cloud resource group.

parameters.name: RuleIds
parameters.description: The IDs of the protection rules to delete. Separate multiple IDs with commas (,).

parameters.name: TemplateId
parameters.description:
The ID of the protection template to delete.
> This parameter is required only when **DefenseType** is set to **template**.
